english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for enclosing an object in paper, cloth, or similar material.
This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for enveloping someone or something in a protective covering.

examples.english: I wrap the present in paper.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 zi2 baau1 zyu6 fan6 lai5 mat6

examples.english: I cocoon the hot-water bottle in a towel so it stays warm longer.
examples.traditional: 我用毛巾包住個暖水袋，等佢冇咁快凍。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 mou4 gan1 baau1 zyu6 go3 nyun5 seoi2 doi2 dang2 keoi5 mou5 gam3 faai3 dung3

english.note: Use this when something physically encloses or contains something, especially by wrapping around it.

examples.english: The walls encompass the whole garden.
examples.traditional: 四邊嘅圍牆包住成個花園。
examples.jyutping: sei3 bin1 ge3 wai4 coeng4 baau1 zyu6 sing4 go3 faa1 jyun4
